notes.title: Cold Shell dev progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I haven't posted on Steam for awhile. But the development of Cold Shell is going well. Let me give you a short list of current progress so far:
[list]
[*] - main story is 90% complete (i am focused on the final act 3)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/f1cc27ff8c9dbb1e2ea16ee3c2ec6be9a5fd99ed.png[/img]
[*] - secondary missions are 60% done (they take less time to create, but are based on main missions assets)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/b78416a32d6cee11be5e7d5c93f76e068d0de73e.png[/img]
[*] - room customization is 100% ready (all the art is ready and implemented in game)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/3504dbbce83fc082ceff5e7f5c6e9fa5aaf12fb7.png[/img]
[*] - battle system, active skills and passives are 95% ready (it all works, but needs more balancing)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766255/42b269cdbcbf0f20d6e941418a0a0ad2c27f8101.gif[/img]
[/list]

I am not certail about any release dates. And i hate giving any false promises. But I move steadily towards the release.

You can always check my [url=https://twitter.com/Brutal_Muse_S]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/coldshell]IndieDB[/url] where i keep posting stuff.

notes.title: Minor demo patch
notes.content:
Just a minor update to make the demo more tidy

* Fixed a few typos in the quest texts
* Removed the red "save warning" sign, that sometimes spawned for no reason in the room

notes.title: Small fixes for the demo
notes.content:
DEMO patchlist:
* bridge boss could attack too fast on some systems, not any more
* added an Interference on the map screen in room, when the protagonist is ready to fight - for visibility
* tutorial levels now have the "light" correctly connecting the hint button to the skill icon
* made the "stop music" levels' exits wider - for a more comfortable mission completion
* now some texts under the quest banner will fade a bit, for a better look

Thanks to the people who reached out to me and told me about those issues, you are awesome! 

Also, those fixes will be included to the full version.

notes.title: Progress update
notes.content:
[b]Cold Shell[/b] now has a new trailer and screenshots!
I've updated the store page, to show you the development progress.

Old screenshots and video no longer reflect the current state of the game. A lot of work has been done, and much more needs to be done. You can see 2nd act (corporate offices) and updated character leveling options. 

Also, there is now a partial controller support label. The game can be played with a gamepad (i've used xbox), except for a couple of moments, such as entering the name of the character. If you are ok with the default name, then this is not a problem at all.

The game is about 70% ready. I hope to release it by the end of the year, if all goes well. Indie developers often have something going wrong, so no dates until I'm sure.

Add to wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080680/Cold_Shell/
